encoding: rows 0-1 lit rgb, rows 2-3 unlit rgb; alpha = (log10(tau) + 9) / 10 (tau 1e-9..10) with tau the normal optical depth (alpha 0 = no ring); opacity along a slant = 1 - exp(-tau / |mu|)
colour: sRGB display values; alpha is linear data
import: uncompressed, no mips, wrap U clamp, alpha not sRGB
adamsArcsNote: 2020s state: Fraternité and Égalité clear, Courage and Liberté faded (de Pater et al. 2018; JWST 2022)
note: Arc longitudes are relative to the Courage arc's leading end; they move along the ring at the Adams mean motion
